content: Uplerlawna hopopanni mak ktorreria puk ke' mak kapniopna

Noma a'umkek nana hopopna mak karuri-kalai id to'a nwatiawu Ilyamou-Watyatoha pa nernu, de wowta-kakma npupun nana pa emek naniayarni, ne ohni ida, nle'lu nan o'tani. La' gaini mana emeka lera layarni ne lakni emekneka ai lomarni.
La limni de e ntorreria puk ke'a pniopna ida mere nahniari. Lakni walli malganan de natnikil la tah'i lawna, ne lakni walli malwiru de natnikil la nohkerna.
Ne nhaun de emolmolla ohpora-ohdiawra rapolu. La'pa nhaun pa nhorwua dewade kukur lawna nwahla nhiaunnu pa re'eni wo'itu.
La'pa kukru de nhaur re'eni wo'itu, dewade agiwa ghorta lira re, mere a'utlin de lira ida nwatiaga Ilyamou-Watyatoha pa niwra: “Muwunmua hya' maka kukru wo'itu re rakotkota ne yana mhuorta re.”
Ne hopopan mak khapet tiarga lora me ra' de nran limni walli malganan la lyanti marna

pa nwet la Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu nanni, totpa naplol nohora hopopan de lirni. Yoma Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu ed mak kden la Ilwo'itu-Darwionema (Sorga), Makohi-maka'ara, kawilla-kayomtia noheri-woru lyanti nayanni, ne E' ed mak kodi plolli pa nodi liarni. Hopopan de niwra: “Ee, ler maka rawuwu-rawei ntutu-nte' olek di. Pede dodo'ondi de Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu hota Nhi' nana-nyap niana hya' maka Net tiarg oleka wa.

Yoma la'pa ratlin nana hopopna wo'itnu de nega noknokni, de hota Uplerlawna Nhi' nana-nyap niana hya' maka Nano'targ oleka wa mere ululu rimormiori raplin mua'ta, de Nlernohora hya' mak Enakot nohora oleka la makwohorulu-ktatrulu mak khima-kre' E kniarni.”

Nhor nioma lira mak kwatiaga Ilyamou-Watyatoha mak a'utlin olek de, nakot owa'an mai a'u niwra: “Mlia' pa mua'ala puka pniopna mak kawnieran de la'a hopopan mak khapet tiarga lora-ra' de limni ralamni.”
Pede alia wuaka puka pniopna ku' della hopopan de. Noma nakot mai a'u: “Mu'ala hadi pa mu'una. Hota omu'una de, nmer lia apanmu, mere hota la' o nurmu de minmi'na emeka gan tiuru.”
Dewade aga'ala puka pniopna ku' della limni ralamni pa a'una. La a nu'ru de nwoliamnia gani turnu. Mere atiella de a apnu ndorni-ndehen nohor mernu.

Nhorwua noma nhopan pa alia ukot nohor owa'an la'a hya' maka Uplerlawna Nror targa (Nakot targa) oleka pa hota hairi-hairi, me la'a noh pa'etu-rai piatatra nora leta-leta ror wut nieka wniareini-wniahaurnu honona hota ha rlernana.
